response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_average FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_average FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT sa.observstation, sa.station_average, sa.station_average - oa.overall_average as difference_above_overall FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_average > oa.overall_average ORDER BY difference_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Missing bandwidth values are NULL in the database and excluded from average calculations using WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL.
